notes.title: Guadalindie 2025 feedback Patch!
notes.content: [p]Last may we had the pleasure to have you playing the game in Guadalindie with the just released Chapter 4 update.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41160923/bcbdbcca71c554a4adcba09011f6b39e5d56e145.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We are very thankfull for your good feedback on the event and the help to identify which areas we have to improve Chapter 3 and 4.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41160923/936da4ce2d6e2e78fe767cb68f2eeb0ec5bb22d7.gif"][/img][/p][p]Down below you have the improvements of the update:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Inventory visualization improvement.[/p][/*][*][p]Repositioned Chapter 3 batteries, added some sound to detect them easier as well.[/p][/*][*][p]Jump mechanic, giving some sound feedback when landing and added a 10% plus to jump for gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved visual guidances in Chapter 3 for the prototype.[/p][/*][*][p]Now you can see SilverBall's path at some distance when its sticked to a green panel.[/p][/*][*][p]C.A.D.I. will detect your failure in earlier laboratory rooms and will advise you for your own good.[/p][/*][*][p]SilverBall dissapear animation improved.[/p][/*][*][p]Remapped skip dialogue key to allow you perform some hops while you are talking on a SilverPhone.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Chapter 4 is now available!
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Twi6JC4B_64

Hello again players!

We've just released the fourth chapter (of five) of the game [b]"R&D Laboratory"[/b]: while you are trying to help your workmates to make a backup of the company's systems, you will branch off your path to end up exploring the different rooms of the laboratory. Your intellect and the new gadget "SilverGlove" will be your only allies to reach your objective.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41160923/0bb29ccf523c9c7b7c8fe758c2fcbb1654893c75.png[/img]
Manage gravity at your will and charge the SilverBall throwing it against the different laboratory's panels and try not to draw your superior's attention. Your journey at SilverCup is not going unnoticed and in the next (and last) chapter "We are a family" you will discover which side you are on. [b] Will you change the system or, like everyone else, will you join it?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41160923/02ea5b8c064b75a83f1952cae592b698a4af2967.png[/img]
The next update will be the last one of Lost and Found - What if I come and find it before [b]leaving early access in 2026 with the fifth and last chapter of the story mode[/b], completely finishing the development of the game and reaching the 1.0 version.

[list]
[*] Chapter 4 released
[*] Improved visualization system of the inventory items
[*] Gameplay improvements
[*] Bugfixes
[*] New achievements
[/list]

[i]Chapter 4 french translation coming soon.[/i]

notes.title: Chapter 3 The Showroom now available!
notes.content:
In this new Chapter 3 The Showroom you will discover new areas of SilverCup, diving deep into the company and without any help, like the good employee that you are. Do you think you will survive without asking for help using your SilverPhone? Discover it in the new update of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41160923/03c5b419ae4c1179ca165d283aa0340e33210a91.gif[/img]

In addition the patch includes the following changes:

[list]
[*]Added 3 new achievements from Chapter 3.
[*]Reworked the inventory system: now it is needed to solve some puzzles.
[*]Interactions and visual guidances improved in Chapters 1&2.
[*]New in-game cinematic system. Added some in Chapters 1&2.
[*]Original music added for Chapter 2.
[*]Added new lost items for the Arcade mode, one from the survival horror game Shadows of Duat.
[*]Added new footsteps system that works with the material of the floor.
[*]Added new ways to unlock mails. Some of them are protected by password that you need to discover or by using a floppy disk hidden in the level.
[*]Bugfixing related to gameplay, audio, etc...
[/list]

Chapter 4 already in development phase...

notes.title: Community feedback changes patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41160923/ad2215a8a7fad3f63281633007492e5f79230336.jpg[/img]

After our assistance to Seville Mangafest 2023 some of you had the chance to test the game and give your feedback about Chapter 1&2 of the story mode. We want to appreciate your commitment to the game and we have been working on some adjustments to the game based on your feedback.

The list of changes is the following:

[list]
[*] Mass changes in lot of objects, light and medium objets will not fall if they are close to the player
[*] Objects are now grabbed closer to the camera.
[*] Glasses on the recycle game are now red. Napkins are now a bit bigger.
[*] Adding 20 more seconds to the hard mode of chapter 1.
[*] Added responsiveness to the crosshair.
[*] Interaction distance with objects have been reduced drastically now it is not possible to interact with doors far away.
[*] Fixed a bug that was preventing to hide the tutorials.
[*] Improved spacebar icon.
[*] Roquefort now look at the object after arriving to the posible destination.
[*] Crouch and quest tutorial have been improved.
[*] Motorbyke keys animation fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Arcade mode's finished! (patch v0.42)
notes.content:
A little more than a year ago, we launched the Early Access for Lost and Found - What if I come and find it, and today we want to celebrate it with a patch which [b]includes everything we had planned when we desgined the arcade mode[/b]. We are still open to suggestions from the community to include to the arcade mode. We believe in the potential of this mode if the community wants such thing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41160923/044fd3a85b593b7833e8eb7df9ff03b59c167f77.gif[/img]

We are proud of the current state of the arcade mode because it lays the foundations for the playable mechanics of the story mode. It's full of new features, detailed below:

[list]
[*] New pack, "Even more lost", with 12 new lost objects.
[*] Third helper: the cart, a tool which will allow you to carry several items at the same time. Be careful not to load it too much.
[*] Added new achievements.
[*] [i]In game[/i] user interface fully redesigned and improved.
[*] Added an accessibility option which allows to change the subtitles size.
[*] Redecorated break room.
[*] Enlarged hall plus hall of fame makeover.
[*] Mechanics improvements and bug fixing.
[/list]

We hope you like the new content, and we want to tell you that we have started with enthusiasm the development of the story mode. We will keep you updated about it via Twitter, Discord and Steam.

[b]In 2023[/b], we hope to bring you more news and the [b]first chapter of the story mode[/b].
Thank you so much for everything!

notes.title: The summer update is here!!
notes.content:

[list]
[*] New movie themed lost objects pack.
[*] New intelligent helper available in three different levels: Hamilton
[*] Power ups: try to beat your best scores  using the coffee of your preference/of your choice.
[*] New achievements based on the new content.
[*] New lost objects for the base pack.
[*] New skybox with dynamic clouds and stars in the night sky.
[*] Visual improvements and animations.

We hope you enjoy it and remember that in a few months the last arcade update will be released with new story mode info. Down below you have some singleplayer screens:

notes.title: Summer update is smooth sailing!
notes.content:
Hi again, players!

We hope that you are having a great start of summer and that you're thrilling to know more about the next update for Lost and Found - What if I come and find it.

As originally intended, we'll have the update ready for next August with lots of new content (it's probably our biggest update so far), including a new helper, power-ups, an items pack, base items and achievements... lots of achievements!

To make the wait shorter, we have thought you'd like to have an original wallpaper of the game, which is starting to lay the groundwork for the story mode's lore. We hope you like it!

See you next month!

(Click on the image to download in higher quality)

notes.title: April update (v0.30)
notes.content:
Hello players!

In this new free update we bring you new performance optimizations, graphics improvements and the Steam leaderboard integrated inside the game, more info below:

-New item outline, which can also be deactivated from the settings of the game.
-TV Screen inside the game where you can check your Lost and Found rank (friends and global). Try to beat your friends scores!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41160923/a273d70d65039bd4d28a47dbe367323802fdc1f6.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy it, new updates incoming.

notes.title: November patch
notes.content:
The version 0.13 includes a bunch of fixes and improvements to enhance the gameplay, some of them requested by the community:

-Completely reworked the grab system, objects will fall when hitting walls
-Improved the randomization of the objects in the shelvings
-Added the possibility to skip the ending score debriefing
-Added slippery behaviour to the tray, be aware!
-Added an option in game settings to invert the throw / drop action for the grab action in the mouse and controller
-Added new lost item: the slipper
-Improved some models: rubik cubes and cards
-Fixed volumetric and postprocessing setting in second match
-Fixed the animation time of the UI in the first note
-Fixed the UI of the note when pausing the game
-Fixed the animation of the duro coin when pausing the game
-Preventing to throw an object when not already holding it
-Fixed the score animation when pausing the game
-Fixed the bug that was preventing to load the objects and open the door
